name: shortlist
description: Shortlist is a free, open-source, self-hosted tool that gives each person on your Plex server their own recommendation rows (Picked for You, Because you watched, Watch it again, seasonal picks, the titles they asked for), built from what they watched and hidden from everyone else. Each user gets personal collection rows built automatically from their own watch history — visible only to them, never to anyone else. Six row kinds and eleven templates to start from. Every pick comes with a plain-English reason written by Shortlist itself. An optional AI provider (Claude / OpenAI / Gemini / local Ollama) can search the web for recent titles and build AI rows from a description, or run it with no AI at all. Only ever recommends titles already in your library, and can optionally ask Radarr/Sonarr for the ones you're missing. Each row is a labeled collection excluded on every other account's share — delivered hidden and only promoted once those exclusions are in place — with a fully reversible uninstall that restores your share filters from a snapshot. Stable 1.x release, running nightly in production; please report issues on GitHub. Website: https://shortlistapp.dev/ · How it compares with other Plex recommendation tools: https://shortlistapp.dev/plex-recommendation-tools/
